songs.title: Be Honour & Glory Forever & Ever
songs.lyrics:
Unto the King eternal, immortal
Invisible, the only wise God

Be honour & glory forever & ever
Be honour & glory forever more

Honour & glory & power & might
Be unto Jesus our King

Be all the honour forever & ever
Be all the glory forever

All adoration
All of the praise
Forever & ever more

songs.title: Shadow Dispelling With Joy I Am Telling
songs.boundaryNote: Stop before 'From Heaven You Came'; that is a different song on the same notebook page.
songs.lyrics:
Shadow dispelling with joy I am telling
He made the darkness depart
Heaven came down and glory filled my soul
When at the cross my Saviour made me whole
My sins are washed away
And my night is turned to day
Heaven came down and glory filled my soul

songs.title: The Lord Giveth a Word of Good Tidings
songs.boundaryNote: Stop before 'In Heavenly Armour We'll Enter the Land'; that is a different song on the same notebook page.
songs.lyrics:
The Lord giveth a word of good tidings
I will press on and make them mine
I'll know His power, I'll know His glory
And in His kingdom I will shine
With the high praises of God in my mouth
And a two edged sword in my hand
We'll wage right on to victory

songs.title: Giving Glory, Giving Honour / Giving Praise Unto the Lamb of God
songs.lyrics:
Giving glory, giving honour
Giving praise unto the Lamb of God
Giving glory, giving honour
Giving praise unto the Lamb of God
Jesus Christ, Lamb of God

songs.title: O Lord, For Thou Art High Above the Earth
songs.lyrics:
O Lord
For Thou art high above the earth
Thou art exalted far above all gods

For Thou O Lord art high
Above the earth
Thou art exalted far above all gods
